priorityList: Cast Metamorphosis if Eradicate is active or in a single-target encounter.
Cast The Hunt or Voidblade immediately if Void Metamorphosis is at maximum stacks.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Cast Void Ray to maintain the Eradicate buff or as a high-priority single-target attack.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are near maximum Collapsing Star stacks.
Execute the Reap priority (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have 4+ souls consumed during Metamorphosis or if Voidfall procs.
Cast Collapsing Star whenever available, provided Dark Matter or Star Fragments are active.
Cast Vengeful Retreat if Voidstep is active and Collapsing Star stacks are not yet at the limit.
Cast Reapers Toll if Voidsurge is proc'd.
Cast The Hunt as a primary damage cooldown.
Cast Pierce the Veil on Voidsurge procs or for resource generation.
Cast Voidblade as your primary filler if talented into Duty Eternal or Devourer's Bite.
Use Devour and Consume as baseline fillers to generate resources.
Use damage trinkets and combat potions during Metamorphosis windows for maximum burst.
